name: Zentra aToken burn clamp lets repayWithATokens clear debt without burning
summary: Zentra, an Aave V3 fork on Citrea, upgraded its aTokens to an implementation whose _burnScaled caps the scaled burn at the holder's scaled balance with no bound on the difference. Pool.repayWithATokens burns the caller's aTokens and marks the debt repaid, so a caller holding no aTokens repays in full while burning nothing. With 200,000 flash-borrowed USDC.e as collateral, the attacker borrowed 140,000 ctUSD, cleared the debt with repayWithATokens and withdrew the collateral. It repeated this for 30 USDC.e.

loss.notes: Net reserve depletion in the single exploit transaction. The zctUSD reserve paid 140,000 ctUSD in the borrow and received 0.000001 ctUSD net from the attacker's 50 supplied and 49.999999 withdrawn. The zUSDC reserve paid the 30 USDC.e borrow and kept 0.000001 of the 200,000 USDC.e collateral supplied and withdrawn. The debt tokens were burned without repayment. The PoC reports ~140,000 ctUSD + 30 USDC.e (~$143K).

ageReset.description: PoolConfigurator 0x6864042da4a5bbeb2a98e910599964c9d8b7b684, called by Zentra deployer 0x76be77a1, upgraded the zctUSD proxy from ATokenV2 0x2ec995d521d5248c15b874a5cfb80c65a7dc63f7 to AToken 0x62ff719a, which added the uncapped burn clamp. zUSDC 0x01465912c8cec266237050f429fe1b88daa56c0a received the same implementation two blocks earlier (block 9161294).

sources.note: Root cause, target and anchor. Verified source on the Citrea Blockscout (explorer.mainnet.citrea.xyz /api/v2/smart-contracts): AToken 0x62ff719abcaedead9055ba980fce3821ebdda694 (v0.8.19) ScaledBalanceTokenBase._burnScaled computes amountScaled = _scaleForBurn(amount, index), then `if (amountScaled > scaledBalance) amountScaled = scaledBalance;` before _burn, so a holder with scaled balance 0 burns nothing. The replaced ATokenV2 0x2ec995d521d5248c15b874a5cfb80c65a7dc63f7 uses amount.rayDiv(index) with no clamp, so its checked _burn reverts. The Pool (proxy 0xfb7908150b738e7db9862007c66c9eb7850706f5, impl 0x93c562dc08d7b25370cee0132ddabfb85839db18) exposes repayWithATokens with onBehalfOf = msg.sender and no role. Receipt of source-1 (block 12428145, index 1, EOA 0xa73d72d6 calling 0x8d85840f, which had no code at block 12428144): Algebra pool 0x172d2ab5 flash of 200000 USDC.e (log 0); supply of 200000 USDC.e (logs 4, 7); variableDebtZenctUSD 0x5eea9a01 mints 140000 (log 14); ctUSD 140000 from zctUSD to attacker (log 17); debt burns 140000.000001 (log 19); zctUSD emits a Burn of 140000.000001 from an address with zctUSD balanceOf 0 at block 12428144 (log 24), with no zctUSD balance change; USDC.e collateral 199999.999999 withdrawn (log 31). The same sequence for USDC.e: supply 50 ctUSD (log 34), borrow 30 USDC.e (logs 42, 45), debt burns 30.000001 (log 47) with a zUSDC Burn of 30.000001 (log 50), withdraw 49.999999 ctUSD (log 57). Flash repaid 200020 USDC.e (log 59); the EOA receives 139999.999999 ctUSD and 9.999999 USDC.e (logs 63-64). Age: Blockscout getLogs for Upgraded (0xbc7cd75a...) on zctUSD proxy 0xba2a69b92e0071924c387a200409b658e4f6cac8 up to block 12428145 gives two events: 0x2ec995d5 at block 2971671 and 0x62ff719a in source-3 (block 9161296, index 0, log 0, sender 0x76be77a1 via PoolConfigurator 0x6864042d). The EIP-1967 implementation slot is 0x2ec995d5 at 9161295 and 0x62ff719a at 12428144. The proxy was CREATEd by PoolConfigurator 0x6864042d in source-2 (block 2808192, index 0, initial implementation 0x777a1e500fc20b2d09d20097af6ca6e8dc5fc0e1 without an Upgraded event). Implementation created in source-5 (block 9160909, index 0, creator 0x76be77a1); eth_getCode empty at 9160908; keccak256(runtime) = 0x8b0c848e...5e4d at 9160909 and 12428144. Earliest exercise: Blockscout getLogs for Pool Repay events (0xa534c8db...) from block 9161294 to 12428145 gives 457 events; only two have useATokens = true, both in source-1.

Loss. Reserve flows in source-1 from the logs above: ctUSD 0x8d82c4e3c936c7b5724a382a9c5a4e6eb7ab6d5d (6 decimals) out of zctUSD: 140000000000 (log 17) + 49999999 (log 57); in: 50000000 (log 34); net -139999999999 = -139999.999999 ctUSD. USDC.e 0xe045e6c36cf77faa2cfb54466d71a3aef7bbe839 (6 decimals) out of zUSDC: 199999999999 (log 31) + 30000000 (log 45); in: 200000000000 (log 4); net -29999999 = -29.999999 USDC.e.
